text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "In Switzerland no one person is ever head of state", "gist": "Switzerland does not have a single permanent head of state"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The president of the Confederation is 'primus inter pares' – first among equals – for one year", "gist": "Swiss Confederation president is a one-year rotating role with no superior authority"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "one year", "gist": "Term length of the Swiss Confederation president"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "United Federal Assembly", "gist": "Body that elects the Swiss Confederation president"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council", "gist": "Collective body that performs presidential duties together"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "collectively receives foreign heads of state on state visits", "gist": "Federal Council jointly receives foreign heads of state during official visits"}]}
